# P1

> Every page of the P1 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [P1 PHR identity and profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1): How a patient gets into their own PHR: registration, login, the profile they see, the family members they manage.
- [01 - Get Health Records List [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-01-get-health-records-list-get): Lists the health records held in the person's DigiLocker.
- [02 - Get DigiLocker Account [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-02-get-digilocker-account-get): Returns the DigiLocker account linked to the signed-in ABHA address, if one has been connected.
- [03 - Get Access Token / OAuth Callback [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-03-get-access-token-oauth-callback-get): Completes the DigiLocker OAuth flow: exchanges the authorisation code DigiLocker redirected back with for an access token.
- [04 - Get Account Status [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-04-get-account-status-get): Reports whether the person's DigiLocker account is connected and ready to receive records.
- [05 - Upload Record [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-05-upload-record-post): Uploads a file the person holds into their DigiLocker as a health record.
- [06 - Read Uploaded Record [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-06-read-uploaded-record-get): Returns the content of one record the person uploaded to DigiLocker.
- [07 - Fetch Incoming Records List [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-07-fetch-incoming-records-list-post): Lists the records a HIP has sent to the person's DigiLocker within a date range.
- [08 - Fetch Incoming Records Bundle [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-08-fetch-incoming-records-bundle-post): Fetches the FHIR bundle for one care context that a HIP has sent to the person's DigiLocker.
- [09 - Pull / Refresh Records [POST]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-09-pull-refresh-records-post): Asks a HIP to send the person's latest records to DigiLocker. The records arrive later; poll the refresh endpoint for them.
- [1. Get All States](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-get-all-states): Lists every state with its LGD code, for the address section of registration.
- [1. Request OTP for an ABHA registration](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-request-otp): Starts ABHA address registration for a person who already holds an ABHA number, by sending an OTP. loginId is the encrypted ABHA number or Aadhaar.
- [1. Request OTP for a PHR registration](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-1-request-otp-2): Starts ABHA address registration for a person with no ABHA number, by sending an OTP to their mobile. loginId is the encrypted mobile number.
- [10 - Get HIP Refresh Records [GET]](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-10-get-hip-refresh-records-get): Returns the records a refresh pulled from a HIP into DigiLocker, once the pull has completed.
- [2. Get Districts by State Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-get-districts-by-state-code): Lists the districts of a state, keyed by LGD code, for the address section of registration.
- [2. Verify Aadhaar](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-verify-aadhaar): Verifies the Aadhaar OTP for a registration transaction and records the person's consent to use Aadhaar for ABHA.
- [2. Verify OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-2-verify-otp): Verifies the mobile OTP for a registration transaction. authData carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [3. PHR Address Suggestion](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-phr-address-suggestion): Suggests available ABHA addresses from the person's name and date of birth, for a mobile-based registration transaction.
- [3. Search LGD by Pin Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-search-lgd-by-pin-code): Resolves a PIN code to its state and district LGD codes, so the address can be filled from the PIN alone.
- [3. Verify Auth](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-3-verify-auth): Verifies the OTP for a registration transaction started against an ABHA number. authData carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [4. Check PHR Address Existence](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-4-check-phr-address-existence): Checks whether an ABHA address is already taken before the person tries to register it.
- [4. Create Custom PHR Address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-4-create-custom-phr-address): Creates an ABHA address of the person's own choosing, once the registration transaction has been verified.
- [5. Get PHR Suggestions](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-5-get-phr-suggestions): Suggests available ABHA addresses for the registration transaction, built from the person's verified profile.
- [5. Register Details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-5-register-details): Completes mobile-based registration by submitting the person's profile details against the verified transaction, and creates the ABHA address.
- [assign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-assign): Links another ABHA address to the signed-in person's address under a relationship type, so the two profiles are managed as a family.
- [Certificate](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-certificate): Returns the ABDM public key and the encryption algorithm to apply with it. Fetch it before encrypting any value for the PHR application services.
- [De-Link Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-de-link-request): Removes the link between the signed-in ABHA address and an ABHA number, against a verified transaction.
- [delink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-delink): Removes the family link between the signed-in person's ABHA address and the related address given.
- [ENCRYPTION](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-encryption): Encrypts a value with the ABDM public key so it can be sent in the fields that only accept ciphertext, such as loginId and OTP values.
- [Get District with stateCode](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-district-with-statecode): Lists the districts of a state with their LGD codes.
- [Get lgd with pincode](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-lgd-with-pincode): Resolves a PIN code to its state and district LGD codes.
- [Get notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-notifications): Lists the notifications delivered to the signed-in ABHA address.
- [Get PHR Card](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-phr-card): Returns the person's ABHA card as an image for display or download.
- [Get Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-profile): Returns the signed-in person's ABHA profile: name, date of birth, gender and contact details.
- [Get QR Code](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-qr-code): Returns the QR code that encodes the person's ABHA address, for scanning at a facility.
- [Get Relationship Types](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-relationship-types): Lists the relationship types an address can be assigned under, each with the id assign takes.
- [Get States](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-get-states): Lists every state with its LGD code.
- [getProvidersByID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-getprovidersbyid): Returns one provider's registry entry: its identifier, facility type, whether it is registered in the HIP role, and whether it supports scan and pay.
- [IsKycVerified](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-iskycverified): Reports whether the ABHA address given has completed KYC verification.
- [Link Request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-link-request): Links an ABHA number to the signed-in ABHA address, against a verified transaction.
- [linked-by-me](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-linked-by-me): Lists the ABHA addresses the signed-in person has linked to their own as family members.
- [linked-to-me](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-linked-to-me): Lists the ABHA addresses that have linked the signed-in person's address as a family member.
- [Login OTP Verify - AADHAR](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-login-otp-verify-aadhar): Verifies the login OTP. On success the response carries the accounts linked to the identifier and a token for each, or a transaction to pick one with.
- [Logout](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-logout): Ends the session and invalidates its tokens.
- [OTP Request - AADHAR OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-otp-request-aadhar-otp): Starts a login by sending an OTP. loginHint names what the person is identifying with, and loginId is that value encrypted.
- [reassign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-reassign): Moves an existing family link to a different relationship type without delinking and assigning again.
- [Refresh Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-refresh-token): Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token, so the session continues without signing in again.
- [Search Auth Methods - ABHAAddress](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-search-auth-methods-abhaaddress): Returns the authentication methods available for an ABHA address, so the login can offer only the ones that will work.
- [Send AADHAAR Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-aadhaar-otp-link-delink): Sends an Aadhaar OTP to authorise linking or delinking an ABHA number with the signed-in address. loginId is the encrypted Aadhaar.
- [Send ABHA OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-abha-otp): Sends an OTP to the contact registered on the signed-in ABHA address, to authorise a profile change. loginId is encrypted.
- [Send ABHA Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-send-abha-otp-link-delink): Sends an OTP to the ABHA number's registered contact to authorise linking or delinking an ABHA address. loginId is encrypted.
- [Session API](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-session-api): Issues a gateway session token from a client id and secret. The token is the bearer credential for calls on the gateway host.
- [Session-Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-session-token): Issues the access token every PHR application call carries as a bearer token, with its refresh token and both expiry windows.
- [Set the preferred ABHA address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-set-preferred-abha-address): Marks one of the person's ABHA addresses as the preferred one, against a verified transaction.
- [Switch Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-switch-profile): Lists the other accounts the signed-in person can switch to and opens a transaction for the switch.
- [unassign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-unassign): Ends the family relationship with the related ABHA address given, on the signed-in person's side.
- [Update mobile request OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-mobile-request-otp): Sends an OTP to a new mobile number so it can replace the one on the signed-in ABHA address. loginId is the encrypted new number.
- [Update mobile verify OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-mobile-verify-otp): Verifies the OTP sent for a mobile number update on an ABHA address. authData carries the transaction id and the encrypted OTP.
- [Update Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-update-profile): Updates the signed-in person's profile fields: name, date of birth, gender, contact details and photo.
- [Verify AADHAAR Otp - Link-DeLink](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-aadhaar-otp-link-delink): Verifies the Aadhaar OTP for a link or delink transaction and returns the accounts it applies to.
- [Verify ABHA OTP](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-abha-otp): Verifies the OTP sent for a profile change and returns the accounts and tokens it applies to.
- [verify and assign](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-and-assign): Verifies the OTP for a family link transaction and, in the same step, links the given ABHA address under the relationship type. May also unassign a previous...
- [Verify - User](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-user): Completes a login that matched more than one account: selects the ABHA address to sign in as and returns its session tokens.
- [Verify User Switch Profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/endpoints/p1-verify-user-switch-profile): Completes a profile switch: selects the ABHA address to continue as and returns its session tokens.
- [P1 PHR identity and profile errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-11/docs/hiecm/v3/api/p1/errors): What P1 PHR identity and profile returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
